title: Range Addition II
description: Find the count of the maximum integer in an m x n matrix after multiple range increment operations.
pseudocode:
1: minR = m, minC = n
2: for op in ops:
3:   minR = min(minR, op[0])
4:   minC = min(minC, op[1])
5: return minR * minC

steps.note: Initialize minR and minC to matrix dimensions 3x3
